8.37.9.4. iLock_Geography.switch_types.DirObj2NodeTypePaths.generate¶

DirObj2NodeTypePaths.generate(gType=<class iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathgen.sentinel>, gTypeEnd=<class iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathgen.sentinel>, beginFacing=<class iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathgen.sentinel>, endFacing=<class iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathgen.sentinel>)¶

Iterator over the path-tuples of valid paths in railyard that start from and end in nodes containing directed objects.

Parameters:
  • gType (Iterable(str) | str | sentinel) – The user types of the objects starting the valid paths. ‘*’ in gType means all user types. If sentinel, use the value provided by the instance.
  • gTypeEnd (Iterable(str) | none | str | sentinel) – The user types of the objects ending the valid paths. If None, use gType. If sentinel, use the value provided by the instance.
  • beginFacing (bool | none | sentinel) – If True (False), a path is valid only if the starting object is facing (trailing). An argument of None can be interpreted as “no restriction”. If sentinel, use the value provided by the instance.
  • endFacing (bool | none | sentinel) – If True (False), a path is valid only if the object ending it are facing (trailing). An argument of None can be interpreted as “no restriction”. If sentinel, use the value provided by the instance.
Return type:

Iterable(tuple(NodeIndex, tuple(IEdge), NodeIndex))
Returns:

An iterator returning (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex).
